[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/11 (Thu) 13:33  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To accomplish the tasks you have described, you will need to perform the following steps:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Create two additional VLANs:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Commands to create VLANs:  
```
switch# configure terminal
switch(config)# vlan 2
switch(config-vlan)# name VLAN2
switch(config-vlan)# exit
switch(config)# vlan 3
switch(config-vlan)# name VLAN3
switch(config-vlan)# exit
```  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assign ports 25 through 36 to VLAN2, and ports 37 through 48 to VLAN3:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Commands to assign ports to VLANs:  
```
switch(config)# interface range FastEthernet0/25 - 36
switch(config-if-range)# switchport mode access
switch(config-if-range)# switchport access vlan 2
switch(config-if-range)# exit
switch(config)# interface range FastEthernet0/37 - 48
switch(config-if-range)# switchport mode access
switch(config-if-range)# switchport access vlan 3
switch(config-if-range)# exit
```  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Enable inter-VLAN routing:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Commands to enable inter-VLAN routing:  
```
switch(config)# interface Vlan1
switch(config-if)# no ip address
switch(config-if)# exit
switch(config)# interface GigabitEthernet0/1
switch(config-if)# no ip address
switch(config-if)# no shutdown
switch(config-if)# exit
switch(config)# interface Vlan2
switch(config-if)# ip address 192.168.2.1 255.255.255.0
switch(config-if)# no shutdown
switch(config-if)# exit
switch(config)# interface Vlan3
switch(config-if)# ip address 192.168.3.1 255.255.255.0
switch(config-if)# no shutdown
switch(config-if)# exit
```  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Configure the switch to use the Asus router as its default gateway:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Command to configure default gateway:  
```
switch(config)# ip default-gateway 192.168.1.1
```  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Configure the switch to act as a DHCP server for VLAN2 and VLAN3:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Commands to configure DHCP server:  
```
switch(config)# ip dhcp pool VLAN2
switch(config-dhcp)# network 192.168.2.0 255.255.255.0
switch(config-dhcp)# default-router 192.168.2.1
switch(config-dhcp
